qualification: Exploratory comparison: installed Electron release versus current uncommitted Tauri migration; different UI/API builds, not a controlled framework-only comparison.

methodology.order: One discarded warmup per app, then alternating Electron/Tauri and Tauri/Electron pairs.
methodology.startup: Process spawn to API health HTTP 200 and main page document.readyState=complete with >100 visible text characters and at least one button. CDP polling at 100 ms; does not prove React hydration or first visible window.
methodology.profile: Fresh isolated installation/profile per app; reused after warmup. OS file caches not flushed. APPLIO_NO_ENV=1; setup screen, no Python engine/model loaded.
methodology.idle: 10 seconds after document ready, then three process-tree samples 2 seconds apart; per-run median private bytes and working set.
methodology.memory: All descendants of launcher via Win32_Process ParentProcessId, including Next.js, Node API (Electron), WebView2/GPU/renderer. Private bytes are process commit, not physical RAM. Summed working sets double-count shared pages.
methodology.cpu: CPU deltas for surviving PIDs between first/last idle samples, normalized to all logical CPUs. Short-lived children between samples may be missed.
methodology.size: Logical file bytes, excluding installation data, uninstaller and icon. Shared system WebView2 excluded. No matched Electron installer is available; download size not compared.
methodology.instrumentation: Local CDP enabled on both apps for this run only; same sampling harness. No production app changes.
